name: Rajesh Kumar Sharma

educationDetails.institution: Sri Ram College of Commerce, Delhi

manifesto: Develop 500km new metro network in Delhi
Create 2 lakh jobs through MSME promotion
Zero-tolerance anti-corruption drive
Smart city infrastructure in all Delhi districts
24x7 piped water supply to all households
bio: Former Mayor of Delhi, known for urban infrastructure projects and transparent governance. Led multiple civic reforms during his tenure.
aiSummary: Rajesh Kumar Sharma has a strong infrastructure and employment focus. His legislative performance (82% attendance, 47 questions) is above average. Zero criminal cases and moderate asset disclosure build public trust. Primary risk factor: 2024 margin is narrower than 2019.

newsMentions.headline: Sharma inaugurates Delhi flyover project worth ₹420 crore

name: Priya Nair Menon
experience: 10 years in social activism, First-time candidate
manifesto: 100 safe city zones for women in Delhi
Free legal aid to marginalised communities
Universal healthcare access for Delhi residents
Quality government schools in every ward
Open data governance and RTI strengthening

projects.name: Legal Aid Camps
projects.impact: 4,200 underprivileged citizens given free legal aid

bio: Human rights lawyer turned politician, championing marginalized communities for over a decade. Known for pro-bono legal work and women's rights advocacy.
aiSummary: Priya Nair Menon brings strong grassroots credibility as a lawyer-activist. First-time candidate with no legislative track record — her strength lies in social capital and issue-based campaigning. Low asset declaration signals genuine public-service motivation.

bio: IIT graduate who left a corporate career to serve public. Led mohalla clinic initiative in East Delhi. Tech-focused approach to urban governance.
aiSummary: Amit Tiwari's IIT background gives him strong technocratic credibility. His ward-level work demonstrates execution capability. Win probability is low in this constituency but his environmental and tech agenda resonates with young urban voters.

newsMentions.headline: AAP's Tiwari completes 82,000-tree drive in East Delhi

aiSummary: Sunita Devi Yadav is a credible OBC-farmer voice with two legislative wins. One pending criminal case (preventive detention) is a concern but context suggests political motivation. Strong ground network. Faces tough contest against incumbent BJP.

bio: Senior BJP leader and former Commerce Minister. Oversaw major industrial corridors in UP. Three-time winner from Lucknow.

aiSummary: Ravi Shankar Das is a veteran with strong ideological positioning but declining electoral relevance in Bengal. PhD background gives him depth on policy but his last win was 2004. Low win probability in current political climate.
